title: Write-up Generator
summary: Functions that turn a t.test() or cor.test() result into an APA sentence fragment, with the right df, decimals and p.
hints: The pieces of an `htest`: `test$statistic`, `test$parameter` (the df) and `test$p.value`. Wrap them in `unname()` if the names get in the way.

`fmt_df()` is given: it writes a whole-number df as 58 and Welch's df as 41.73. So `sprintf("*t*(%s) = %s, *p* %s, *d* = %s", fmt_df(test$parameter), fmt_num(test$statistic), fmt_p(test$p.value), fmt_num(d))`.
